# Colorwise.me

> > Colorwise.me is a personal color analysis platform that helps users discover their ideal color palettes through self-guided analysis and AI-powered styling recommendations.

Colorwise.me provides tools for color draping, personal palette discovery, and wardrobe styling. The platform combines color analysis science with practical fashion applications to help users make informed clothing and styling choices based on their unique skin tone and color harmony.

## Key Topics

- Personal Color Analysis
- Color Palette Discovery
- Color Draping
- Skin Tone Analysis
- Capsule Wardrobe
- Color Matching
- Wardrobe Styling
- Personal Styling
- Fashion Tool
- Self-Analysis
- Color Adviser
- Palette Builder
- Shopping Tool
- Wardrobe Builder

## Core Analysis Tools

- [Color-analyze yourself like a PRO](https://colorwise.me): Homepage for Colorwise.me personal color analysis platform and mobile app
- [Self-Analysis Tool](https://colorwise.me/self-analysis): Self-guided color analysis tool for personal palette discovery
- [Color Adviser](https://colorwise.me/color-adviser): Color adviser feature providing personalized styling recommendations

## Palette & Styling Tools

- [Palette Builder](https://colorwise.me/palette): Palette builder and color matching tool for wardrobe styling
- [Personal Color Palette](https://colorwise.me/{{palette.link}}): Personal color palette display and sharing feature for users
- [Capsule Wardrobe Palettes](https://colorwise.me/capsule-palettes): Capsule wardrobe palette builder for coordinated fashion planning

## Legal & Privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://colorwise.me/legal/web-privacy.html): Privacy policy covering data collection, cookies, and user information
